title: Intro to Transformers
description: Club notes from the talk: attention, positional encodings, and why scaling works.
body:
## Why transformers

Self-attention lets every token look at every other token. That is the idea behind the club's intro talk.

## Try it

Start with a tiny encoder, then add positional encodings.
